metadata.gitb:name: Remote Qualified Electronic Signature
metadata.gitb:description: This scenario will test the digital wallet qualified electronic signature functionality, where the document to be signed is retrieved as defined in ETSI 119 432 v1.3.1.

gitb:actor.gitb:name: Relying Party
gitb:actor.gitb:desc: The Relying Party that will be used for testing and that will make available the document for signing.

gitb:actor.gitb:name: Simulated Document Retrieval
gitb:actor.gitb:desc: An actor that simulates a document retrieval request.

gitb:actor.gitb:name: Wallet
gitb:actor.gitb:desc: The Wallet that will be tested against the Relying Party.
